Package ui11.graphics

Interface Surface

All Known Subinterfaces:
NativeWindowSurface, RenderableSurface
All Known Implementing Classes:
AWTFrameSurface, ClippedSurface, DOMSurface, GlassSurface, J2DSurface, J2DSurface.ClippedJ2DSurface, J2DSurface.ReshapedJ2DSurface, J2DSurface.StrokeJ2DSurface, J2DSurface.TransformedJ2DSurface, ShapedSurface, Subsurface, TransformedSurface
public interface Surface
Information about a graphical output, e.g. a whole window, or an arbitrary shaped part of the screen.
